title: The X tensor presentation followed by the tensor-model target
statement: Let a:Λ→Λ′ and f:X→Y be as in [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons], and let tX:TensorNormalization(a,X) satisfy TensorNormalized. For every homotopy complex P over Λ on Y, put FP=Fh(P) for ordinary pullback F, and form eH from the ordinary coefficient isomorphism e of [new-integral-residue-ordinary-tensor-square]. Then tX.derived at L_Λ(f)(Qh(P)), followed by scalarTensorPullModelTarget(a,f,P) of [def-sfb-internal-scalar-tensor-pull-models], is V_X(D_X(γ_f(P))) followed by V_X of the scalar counit at FP, exact restriction’s factorization at the scalar extension of FP, and Qh of the ordinary X tensor presentation followed by inverse homotopy single-tensor comparison and eH.inv whiskered by FP. No Y tensor normalization or scalar base-change comparison is assumed.

proof.text: Any TensorNormalized presentation equals the canonical presentation. Compare on a K-flat resolution, where the localization tensor comparison is invertible, and then extend to every derived object by naturality. The ordinary_hom field identifies the ordinary presentations.

Apply tensorPullCounit_fac with the exact pullback functor, its computation counit, the restricted regular coefficients, the scalarTensorRegularPullIso coefficient comparison, and the restricted scalar-extension derived counit. Its coefficient hypothesis is scalar_regular_pull_counit.

Expand the canonical tensor presentation and its derived counit. The defining tensor-presentation equation identifies the remaining counit with exact restriction followed by the ordinary balanced tensor presentation. Functoriality and associativity give the asserted order.

theorem scalar_pull_tensor_counit (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (tX : TensorNormalization a X)
    (hX : TensorNormalized a X tX)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Modules Λ Y) (.up ℤ)) :
    let F := CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f
    let FP := (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let e := CondensedRing.residueOrdinaryRestrictedRegularPullIso Λ Λ' a f
    let eH := (F.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).app
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (B₀ a Y)) ≪≫
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).mapIso
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app (B₀ a Y) ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso e)
    tX.derived.hom.app ((L Λ f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        scalarTensorPullModelTarget a f P =
      (V a X).map ((D a X).map ((pullCounit (Λ := Λ) f).app P)) ≫
        (V a X).map ((scalarCounit a X).app FP) ≫
        (V₀ a X).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app
          (((extension a X).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj FP) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          ((Mod.tensorPresentationHomotopyIso (coefficientMap a X)).hom.app FP ≫
            (homotopyTensorSingleIso (B₀ a X)).inv.app FP ≫ eH.inv ▷ FP)
